name: Monomi
source: A sentient stuffed rabbit and the lead teacher of the students' school trip. Monomi is sweet, sensitive, and a bit of a crybaby. As the students grow suspicious of each other due to Monokuma's influence, Monomi works hard all by herself to keep their spirits up. For this reason, she's a frequent target of Monokuma's bullying. Furthermore, the students always yell at her whenever she tries to help them.
